prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 15-second Douyin-style livestream sales video with an adult passionate sales anchor in an authentic high-end studio surrounded by phones and tablets. From 0-5 seconds, use a split screen: a blurry distorted AI-video example with a red cross on the left and a cinematic Seedance-generated example on the right. The anchor slaps the table, leans toward the lens, and speaks at an excited rap-like speed about stopping poor models and introducing a Seedance 2.0 price offer. From 5-10 seconds, show a phone close-up as she inputs "Cyberpunk rainy night, girl looking back"; the progress bar fills and a 4K-style result appears with visible hair detail. She points at the screen and praises the speed and lighting. From 10-15 seconds, show a large three-second countdown and a yellow Free Trial shopping-cart icon as she clasps hands and points to the call-to-action area. Preserve source claims as promotional dialogue, do not invent guarantees, and avoid saliva spray or unsafe contact.
prompt.negative_prompt: misleading guarantee, fabricated endorsement, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, blurry, watermark, garbled text, distorted UI, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
